name: The McBirney household at 1625 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_mcbirney_hugh_j

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1625 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1625 Mr. & Mrs. Hugh J. McBirney.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1625, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 36, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The four live-in staff and two children it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.
